title: Toyota +4.54%. Canada +0.86%. Same Two Days.
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

Washington put 50% tariffs on Canadian goods after trade talks collapsed. Four days earlier the same two sides had agreed to cut them — cars to 15%, steel and aluminum to 25%.

So we measured the two days the market spent holding that deal: August 19 close to August 21 close, using closing prices only.

Toyota +4.54%. Honda +4.58%. The Canada ETF: +0.86%. The S&P 500 fell 0.43% over the same two days.

The country in every headline moved least. The manufacturers moved five times more. This was priced through factories, not through flags.

We measured what moved and how much, in one window. We did not measure why, and we do not forecast policy.

pinnedComment:
The number that surprised us: the Canada ETF moved +0.86% while Toyota moved +4.54% — on the same two days, with the S&P down 0.43%. The country in the headline moved least.

We measured moves, not causes, and we do not forecast policy. Anchor for tonight is EWC at 62.36, the last close before the 50%.

evidence: FMP stable historical-price-eod/full — daily closes for TM, HMC, EWC, EWJ, EWY, SPY, 2026-08-12 to 2026-08-25, pulled 2026-08-24
Two-day move computed from closes 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-21: TM +4.54%, HMC +4.58%, EWY +2.24%, EWC +0.86%, EWJ +0.42%, SPY -0.43%
⛔ FMP's changePercent field disagrees with its own closes (reports TM +0.37% where the closes give +2.66%), so every figure here is computed from closes, not from that field

Event timeline from Google News RSS in three languages (KR/JP/US), collected 2026-08-24: agreement to cut (autos 15%, steel/aluminum 25%) reported ~102h prior; talks collapsed and 50% imposed ~17h prior; Canadian retaliation announced ~9h prior
Attention measured by scripts/topic-scan.mjs — tariff theme 190 headlines across KR 91 / JP 67 / US 32, freshest 0.6h

Base rate: 1,413 rolling two-day windows of (TM two-day return minus EWC two-day return), 2021-01-04 to 2026-08-21. Median -0.12pt, sd 2.17pt. The 2026-08-21 window reads +3.68pt = 95.8th percentile; windows of that magnitude in either direction occur on 105 of 1,413 days (7.4%)

story.event: Trade talks between the United States and Canada collapsed and 50% tariffs went into effect on Canadian goods — four days after the same two sides had agreed to cut tariffs on cars to 15% and on steel and aluminum to 25%.
story.mechanism: Tariff relief on North American vehicle production was reported in Japanese press as a tailwind for Japanese automakers, who build heavily on this continent. So the repricing showed up in the manufacturers rather than in the country index — the exposure follows plants, not passports.

insight.claim: The two-day gap between Toyota and the Canada ETF reached +3.68 points, against a five-year median of -0.12 — the 95.8th percentile of 1,413 windows
